definition: A cold (job,node) timeline row MATCHES if the instance_id the harness joined to that Slurm node (via private IP) appears on a slurmctld.log line 'POWER: Node <node>/.../<ip> powered up with instance_id=<id>' with the SAME node name. Denominator = cold rows whose instance appears in the saved slurmctld.log (log coverage). Timing agreement is reported separately: t5 (poller) - slurmctld 'powered up' time, and t2 (CloudTrail CreateFleet) - slurm_resume.log 'Launched' line (1 s log resolution).
